models.label: Ideal resistor
models.description: Resistance follows Value. Optional temperature coefficients are available as symbol fields.

models.description: Capacitance follows Value and uses the initial voltage field.

models.label: Ideal inductor
models.description: Linear inductance follows Value.

models.label: Basic potentiometer
models.description: Two resistors in series, with resistance and position controlled by the Value and Wiper fields.

models.label: Generic NPN transistor
models.description: Generic NPN model for circuit experiments.

models.description: Level-one P-channel MOSFET with body tied to source.

models.description: Ideal current source with DC value and optional AC magnitude and phase.

Transformer.template:
LT$(refnum)P %(1) %(2) $(Primary inductance)
LT$(refnum)S %(3) %(4) $(Secondary inductance)
KT$(refnum) LT$(refnum)P LT$(refnum)S $(Coupling)

XTAL (quartz crystal).template: X$(ref) %(1) %(2) TC_XTAL PARAMS: FREQ=$(Frequency) RM=$(Motional resistance) CM=$(Motional capacitance) C0=$(Shunt capacitance)

Ceramic resonator.template: X$(ref) %(1) %(2) TC_CERAMIC PARAMS: FREQ=$(Frequency) RM=$(Motional resistance) CM=$(Motional capacitance) C0=$(Shunt capacitance)

DC / AC voltage source.template: V$(refnum) %(1) %(2) DC $(Value)?(not_empty(AC magnitude), AC $(AC magnitude) $(AC Phase),)

DC / AC current source.template: I$(refnum) %(1) %(2) DC $(Value)?(not_empty(AC magnitude), AC $(AC magnitude) $(AC Phase),)
